name: integrate-gestalt
description: Form a coherent gestalt — the whole that is more than the sum of its parts — from the panoramic perception produced by expand-awareness. Maps tensions and resonances between domains, identifies the emergent figure from the ground of multiple perspectives, tests the candidate whole for premature closure, and articulates the insight in a single sentence no single domain could have produced. Use after expand-awareness has surfaced raw multi-domain perception and before express-insight communicates the result.
